ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Robokidz Eduventures IPO at a median premium of ₹55 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹30 to ₹65. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 63.6% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹106 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 51.89%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 72.74× overall — strong. The issue is open for bidding now (21-23 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (75/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the Robokidz Eduventures IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 24 Sep, with listing expected 28 Sep 2026. For the Robokidz Eduventures IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹31.09 Cr. See also Robokidz Eduventures IPO subscription status and Robokidz Eduventures IPO allotment status. This Robokidz Eduventures IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Varmora Granito IPO grey market premium is ₹4.5 at the median of 6 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹3 and ₹5. The median has slipped ₹5.5 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 44.4% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹148 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 3.04%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.11× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (22-24 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (62/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Varmora Granito IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 25 Sep, with listing expected 29 Sep 2026. For the Varmora Granito IPO, one lot is 101 shares and the issue size is ₹708.02 Cr. See also Varmora Granito IPO subscription status and Varmora Granito IPO allotment status. This Varmora Granito IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Anand Seamless IPO GMP today is ₹0, with all three trackers we monitor quoting a nil grey market premium (GMP) ahead of the 22-24 Sept bidding window. Against the ₹72 upper price band that implies a 0% listing gain as quoted, on an upcoming ₹26 crore SME issue with a 1,600-share lot.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Anand Seamless IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 25 Sep, with listing expected 29 Sep 2026. For the Anand Seamless IPO, one lot is 1600 shares and the issue size is ₹26 Cr. See also Anand Seamless IPO subscription status and Anand Seamless IPO allotment status. This Anand Seamless IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Moneyview IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹9 today, drawn from 5 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹5 to ₹10. That is ₹9 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Note the disagreement: trackers are 55.6% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹34 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 26.47%; treat it as expectation, not promise. The issue is upcoming, with dates listed as 24-28 Sept; every open and upcoming issue is on the IPO calendar. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (53/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Moneyview IPO is expected to list on 1 Oct 2026. For the Moneyview IPO, one lot is 441 shares and the issue size is ₹1,091.68 Cr. This Moneyview IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The A-One Steels IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹50 today, drawn from 5 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹38 to ₹60. That is ₹10 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Note the disagreement: trackers are 44% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹405 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 12.35%; treat it as expectation, not promise. The issue is upcoming, with dates listed as 24-28 Sept; every open and upcoming issue is on the IPO calendar. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (65/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The A-One Steels IPO is expected to list on 1 Oct 2026. For the A-One Steels IPO, one lot is 37 shares and the issue size is ₹405 Cr. This A-One Steels IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the SS Retail IPO at a median premium of ₹140 — the midpoint of 5 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹135 to ₹152. That is ₹10.5 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Set against the upper price band of ₹424, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 33.02% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 108.69× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (83/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the SS Retail IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 21 Sep, with listing expected 23 Sep 2026. For the SS Retail IPO, one lot is 35 shares and the issue size is ₹500.00 Cr. See also SS Retail IPO subscription status and SS Retail IPO allotment status. This SS Retail IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

allotment_faq.a: The SS Retail IPO is subscribed 108.69 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the NSE IPO at a median premium of ₹50 — the midpoint of 5 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹41 to ₹65. That is ₹10 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Note the disagreement: trackers are 48% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹1785, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 2.8% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 5.71× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (64/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the NSE IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 22 Sep, with listing expected 24 Sep 2026. For the NSE IPO, one lot is 8 shares and the issue size is ₹22,562 Cr. See also NSE IPO subscription status and NSE IPO allotment status. This NSE IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the NSE IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The NSE IPO is subscribed 5.71 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: When does the NSE IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The NSE IPO bidding window is 17-21 Sept. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: What is the NSE IPO lot size?
subscription_faq.a: One lot of the NSE IPO is 8 shares, at a price band of Rs 1785.0.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get NSE IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

The Sonaselection India IPO grey market premium is still at zero across the 4 trackers we track — typical before dealers begin quoting, especially ahead of the price band or dates. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.01× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (55/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Sonaselection India IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 22 Sep, with listing expected 24 Sep 2026. For the Sonaselection India IPO, one lot is 150 shares and the issue size is ₹141.57 Cr. See also Sonaselection India IPO subscription status and Sonaselection India IPO allotment status. This Sonaselection India IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Hero Motors IPO subscribed?
